analysis.title: Range Resources Corp. (RRC): First Take: Solid 3Q26 EPS/EBITDA Beats Versus Consensus; Highlight Continued Capital Efficiencies
key_insights: RRC reported 3Q26 adjusted EPS of $0.81 vs GS estimate $0.84 and FactSet consensus $0.75, and free cash flow of $177 mn vs GS $172 mn and consensus $147 mn.
3Q26 production was 2.50 Bcfe/d, above GS at 2.46 and consensus at 2.45 Bcfe/d. NGLs were 127 Mb/d vs GS 121 and consensus 123, and natural gas was 1,700 MMcf/d vs GS 1,684 and consensus 1,670.
Capex including land, leasehold and other capital spend was $170 mn, below GS $180 mn and consensus $183 mn.
Net debt was $794 mn at 3Q26 end vs $881 mn at 2Q26 end.
EBITDAX was $364 mn vs GS $375 mn and consensus $353 mn. Operating cash flow was $347 mn vs GS $352 mn and consensus $331 mn.
Realized prices after hedges were $2.74/Mcf for gas, $69.33/bbl for oil and $27.47/bbl for NGLs, vs GS $2.78, $67.17 and $27.94.
Total cash costs were $1.84/Mcfe vs GS $1.90. G&A was $0.16/Mcfe vs GS $0.20, and gathering, processing and transport costs were $1.52/Mcfe vs GS $1.55.

GS lists four questions for the earnings call: why now is the right time to sell the business and what shareholders gain, production capacity of the assets and how fast RRC could grow to it in a supportive gas market, flexibility to opt out of firm transport contracts, and the 2027 NGL price outlook given macro volatility.
GS is Not Rated on RRC, so there is no rating or price target. The stock closed at $56.38 on 27 Oct 2026 with a $13.3bn market cap and $13.9bn enterprise value.

GS full-year estimates: 2026E EPS $4.31, 2027E $4.06, 2028E $3.95. EBITDA 2026E $1,724.9 mn, 2027E $1,683.6 mn. Quarterly EPS estimates: 9/26E $0.78, 12/26E $1.22, 3/27E $0.94.
GS valuation estimates: P/E 13.1x for 2026E, EV/EBITDA 8.0x, FCF yield 7.7%, dividend yield 0.7%, net debt/EBITDA 0.3x.
risk_factors: Questions on the call point to uncertainty over 2027 NGL pricing amid macro volatility.
Flexibility to opt out of existing firm transport contracts is an open question.
